task.title: False statement not knowingly made — Reconsideration after 36 months

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the insurability issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — non-insurable employment — [employer’s name].”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In FTS, determine the blocked claim’s status by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed, go to step 3.
If any other status is displayed, go to step 10.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 4.
If all rows are blank, go to step 6.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable status in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next working day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, repeat step 4.
If all rows are blank, go to step 6.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, input the disentitlement on the Disentitlements section as follows (up to 3 disentitlements in BCS can be imposed or rescinded):

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select 14 - Void benefit period .
Start date: Select the w/c of the BPC.
End date: Select Indefinite .
Infraction: Select C - Non-fraud - Insurability - new information .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 9.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 12.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows.

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 7.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NISS.
Infraction: Select C - Non-fraud - Insurability - new information .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim for the insurability of the employment.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “D14 from w/c [XXXX] to 9999.”
Remarks line 2: Type “ACS letter already sent.”
Remarks line 3: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the letter D-01-00-00. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlements (2976) - D5, D12, D13, D14, D23 (3011)
D14 - Claim cancelled - Various reasons (3019):
Select D14 - CRA insurability ruling
Select BPC Date - Sunday’s date (1060)

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no overpayment.
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and active claim .
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and inactive claim .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (4169)

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the A-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Reconsideration beyond 36 months (2595)
Decision reconsidered beyond 36 months due to false representations
BPC date - Sunday’s date (1060)
Right to Request a Reconsideration (4169) .

step.cmd: In NIIS, from Report of Investigation , select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Disentitlement: Select Yes .
Reason: Select Other and type “Non-insurable employment.”
Penalty: Select No .
Warning: Select No .
Violation: Select No .
Select OK .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a CR Recalculation WI pending or unassigned in the related WIs for this BPC:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 16.
If no, go to step 17.

step.cmd: Create an AI WI as follows:

ul.li: Urgent: Check the box.
Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Claim type: Select Revised .
Destination — Level: Select EI Processing .
End User: Select Next available user .
Category: Select Pay affected .
Issue: Select Calculation .
Comments: Type “Level 1 recalculation — Integrity case [Integrity case number].”

Details: Type “ROE [serial number] is not insurable. A recalculation of BPC [DD-MM-YYYY] is not required. Complete the Claim Review Recalculation work item and clear the recalculation registration number for this BPC, if necessary.”
